question:
If, 'A % Z' means 'A is the son of Z',

 

‘A & Z’ means ‘A is the father of Z’,

 

'A × Z' means 'A is sister of Z',

 

&
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 &
 ×
 #
 $
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Father
 Sister
 Mother
 Daughter
 Daughter-in-law
 
 

 

Given: C $ A # E & B % G @ D

It means: C is the daughter of A, A is the mother of E, E is the Father of B, B is the son of G, and G is the Daughter-in-law of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdb6bd47c0988e4b8945f454b1ea24ba95e040298113225703f1f91b1e5a1cc2.png] 

So, C is the **Daughter** of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4)".**
